environment.network: loopback HTTP and simulated WebSocket; dependency audit registry access

tests/fault-injection/external-writes.te: M6 real local HTTP auth throttling retries within budget without dispatching a QQ message
M6 real local HTTP send-body timeout becomes unknown and restart never replays POST
M6 QQ permission loss after authentication blocks once without format fallback
M6 changing a durable recipient binding blocks an already prepared delivery before network access
M6 two SQLite connections claim one send and ignore a late accepted result after Host timeout
M6 GitHub recovery cannot alter QQ or another repository lease
M6 model HTTP 429 preserves incoming events, then resumes the same batch without duplicate effects
M6 model permission loss is not retried and leaves durable source evidence intact
tests/fault-injection/gateway.test.mjs: M6 gateway flood closes at its bounded queue and replays only after the last durable commit
M6 duplicate and old gateway sequences cannot be dispatched twice
M6 shutdown waits for an active durable dispatch and validates dispatch limits
tests/fault-injection/security.test.mjs: M6 access-key rotation revokes existing HTTP sessions while an unchanged key preserves them
M6 repeated failed HTTP logins are throttled without exposing key material
M6 browser writes reject cross-origin, spoofed Host and oversized JSON before authentication succeeds
M6 signed cursors remain bound to actor, project, revision and expiry after permission changes
M6 QQ prompt injection stays untrusted data and raw platform identifiers never enter the model
M6 credentialed QQ, GitHub and model requests refuse redirects to a second server

fixes.finding: Unbounded pending gateway dispatches under a slow durable commit
fixes.resolution: Default 256 pending dispatches; disconnect, drain active commit, resume from durable sequence

fixes.finding: Delivery checked recipient binding only at construction
fixes.resolution: Recheck persisted binding and current authorization before invoking send

fixes.finding: GitHub Sync recovered expired leases outside its repository and service
fixes.resolution: Restrict recovery to payload operations belonging to its repository

fixes.finding: Existing Web sessions survived access key rotation
fixes.resolution: Update account and revoke its sessions transactionally when access hash changes
